newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila shares end higher on technical rebound.
newsitem.headline: Manila shares end higher on technical rebound.

text.p: * Blue chips, secondliners both stage comeback
Manila shares finished slightly firmer on Tuesday on a technical rebound among selected blue chips and secondliners, traders said.
"Selective issues weathered the corrective mood on Monday and made recoveries," said Juanis Barredo, analyst at Citisecurities.
The main index ended up by 20.20 points, or 0.64 percent, to 3,189.98.

Petron Corp shares gained 20 centavos at the close to 9.70 pesos a share. San Miguel B shares also rose by 50 centavos to 86.50 pesos. Secondliner Asian Petroleum rose by 0.30 centavos to 3.70 centavos a share.
"We still have to see if these stocks can sustain the runup," said Teresa Lee, trader at Lippo Securities. She said movement of the main index for the rest of the week will hinge on the Dow Jones.
Barredo added the market will probably remain selective, although some traders said hopes of lower inflation figures may boost sentiment.-KATHERINE ESPINA (632) 841-8937 Fax 8176267
